meta.label: Season 3
meta.source: PBE datamine (client files diffed against live)
meta.caveat: PBE content can change before release.
notes: The datamine reported 40 new augments, but only 39 are named below. One name is missing from the summary.
Some tooltips use placeholders the data does not fill in (for example exact Attack Speed amounts), so some descriptions leave out numbers.
Only augment values were diffed. Other Mayhem rules (snowballs, gold, map) may also have changed and are not covered here.

fame.summary: Earn Fame to unlock bands in order. Each band has its own in-game objectives, member dialogue and six rewards. The final reward is "Welcome to the band!".
fame.relatedCosmetics: True Damage "Know My Name" skins and per-band Prospect/Member icons look like rewards for this track (inferred, not confirmed).

added.name: Big Shot
added.description: +35% Crit Damage and +25% bonus AD; 75% of your Attack Speed is converted to Crit Damage.

added.name: Totentanz
added.description: Summoner spell that blinks you forward and makes you Unkillable. If you don't get a takedown within 5 seconds, you die.

added.name: Group Hug
added.description: A heal or shield also recasts on two nearby allies.

added.name: Mosh Monster
added.description: Casting the ability gives +300–750 HP and slows nearby enemies; takedowns make it stronger permanently.

added.name: Third Times the Harm
added.description: Every third attack deals true damage that grows permanently.

added.name: Bouncing Bees
added.description: After an ability, your next attack bounces. Quest rewards +30 AD and extra bounces.

added.name: Get Jinxed
added.description: Summoner spell that lets you ride a Jinx rocket.

added.name: Brass Blast
added.description: Summoner spell that charges a trumpet knockback.

added.name: BEES!!!
added.description: Ability hits periodically launch a beehive.

added.name: Salvation
added.description: Near-lethal damage releases a shockwave that heals your team.

added.name: Heavy Is The Crown
added.description: AD, AP and AS that grow with takedowns, at the cost of Move Speed; you lose half your stacks on death.

added.name: Weapon of Destiny
added.description: Your first Legendary item grows with takedowns.

added.name: Upgrade Stormsurge
added.description: Squall always explodes, and you get 500 gold.

added.name: Lich Brain
added.description: 30 AP + 4% of bonus HP as AP.
